evidence.quoted_text:
if publication.get('pr_create_pending'):
                raise ValueError('previous PR creation outcome unknown; reconcile existing PR before retry')
evidence.reason: The code already adopts an existing PR by branch and exact head at lines 641-646, but when no PR exists and `pr_create_pending` is set, line 667 unconditionally raises and never clears or retries the pending creation. A crash after line 676 (or a failed `gh pr create`) therefore leaves the branch pushed without a PR and every retry stuck in `publish_failed`. That is an ordinary recovery defect in the publication state machine; a bounded reconcile-and-retry path is the minimal fix.
